#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a cover page PDF using the pdf skill (reportlab)."""
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = "August 1, 2026"  # current date per environment clock

c = canvas.Canvas("cover_page.pdf", pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 0.5 * inch, TITLE)

c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(width / 2.0 - 2.5 * inch, height / 2.0 + 0.1 * inch,
       width / 2.0 + 2.5 * inch, height / 2.0 + 0.1 * inch)

c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 0.5 * inch, DATE_STR)

c.save()
print("Wrote cover_page.pdf")
EOF
